node.title: Declaración provisional reversible
node.summary: A bounded working assumption can support investigation before commitment.

relations: A bounded provisional declaration can enable discovery without being mistaken for the binding ownership decision that the investigation is meant to inform.
No toda falta de información requiere declaración. La provisionalidad no autoriza efectos irreversibles ni elimina el coste de la decisión final.
A focused intervention can begin with a bounded discovery mandate without confusing provisional assumptions with the binding decisions required for production change.
No activar una misión ilimitada con el pretexto de que todo se descubrirá después; la facultad de explorar no incluye todos los efectos.
A reversible provisional declaration can help discover a route between current and target states, while keeping exploration separate from an irreversible ownership or retirement decision.
Double-map deadlock permanece como constructo propuesto; no se demuestra incomputabilidad formal por la falta de un mapa.
